title: Office
description: A government position described by neutral, measurable scope (never a ranking): level, body size, residents per seat, budget the body adopts or administers, term, limits, powers, salary. Candidates' offices_held items and contest agendas link here with office_ref. Path: data/offices/<id>.json

body.description: The body the office-holder sits on, if any (e.g. San Francisco Board of Supervisors).

seats.description: Number of seats in the body (1 for a single executive office).

constituents.description: Residents one office-holder represents; basis says how it was computed.

powers.description: One or two neutral sentences on what the office or body can do.

budget.description: Budget (USD) the body adopts or the department administers; basis names the fiscal year and scope.

links.description: Official site of the office or body, and its node on the CivLab government graph (graph.civlab.org), when CivLab maps it. `npm run import:civlab` reads links.civlab.

legal_basis.description: Where the office is established (constitution article, charter section, statute).

connections.description: How the office connects to others, as neutral counts and verbs (never a ranking): who elects it, what it elects, appoints, confirms or oversees, and which bodies advise it. At most one entry per type; put --merge merges by type.

count.description: Seats or positions involved (e.g. seats it appoints), when the source gives or lets us count them.

bodies.description: Number of distinct bodies involved (e.g. boards and commissions it appoints members to).

targets.description: Names of the offices or bodies on the other end, as the source names them.

text.description: One neutral line, e.g. 'Appoints 403 seats on 74 boards and commissions'.
